Name: Dynamic Game Assets
Author: spacechase0
Description:
[b]Dynamic Game Assets[/b] lets content packs add custom content to the game. It currently supports objects (including bigcraftables), crops (including giant crops), equipment (boots + clothing + hats + weapons), fences, furniture, fruit trees, and recipes (crafting + forge + machine + tailoring). This is meant to eventually replace [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url].

[b][size=5]Install[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url]﻿, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[b][size=5]Use[/size][/b]
[b][size=3]For players[/size][/b]
This mod does nothing on its own; you need to install content packs by unzipping them into your [font=Courier New]Mods[/font] folder. See [i]Requirements[/i] > [i]Mods requiring this file[/i] above to find content packs. Before uninstalling Dynamic Game Assets, make sure you remove any custom content you added in-game.

[b][size=3]For mod authors[/size][/b]
See the [url=https://github.com/spacechase0/StardewValleyMods/tree/develop/DynamicGameAssets#readme]README[/url] for more info.


[b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b]
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5.5+ on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.


[b][size=5]Common questions[/size][/b]
[b][size=3]What's the benefit compared to Json Assets?[/size][/b]
Well, no ID shuffles from installing a new DGA pack, for one.

Besides that, a lot. It supports everything JA does (minus rings that do absolutely nothing) and a little more. It has built-in animation support (for everything), in a way that is more optimized than using Content Patcher Animations. You can change how an object works day-to-day using Content Patcher conditions. Overwriting a content pack won't result in lingering items from old folders. Probably more, I don't have a list.

[b][size=3]Can I use this alongside Json Assets?[/size][/b]
Yes, Dynamic Game Assets was designed in a way that allows it to co-exist with JA, since the transition period to getting everything using this might be a while.

(*) Shirts may act up with Json Assets installed. They might render funny, they might crash you from running out of GPU memory. I have no idea why. Try not to use DGA shirts if you have JA installed.

[b][size=3]Will this work in multiplayer and split-screen?[/size][/b]
It should definitely work for multiplayer. Unsure about split-screen; I might have missed something. Either way, let me know if you encounter any problems.

[b][size=3]Will this work on Android?[/size][/b]
No, this is for Stardew Valley 1.5.4 or later, and Android doesn't have that update yet.

[b][size=3]Will you add ___?[/size][/b]
Probably not, although there are a few things still to do (listed in the top of [font=Courier New]Mod.cs[/font]).

[b][size=3]Is there a converter? Can we migrate existing saves from JA to DGA?[/size][/b]
Coming soon! Probably. If you haven't gotten it in a couple of weeks after this initial release, then perhaps not.

[b][size=3]What about your other mods that use JA?[/size][/b]
Those will be updated within a few weeks from now. Probably.

[b][size=3]What are the known issues?[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Shirts may act up with Json Assets installed. They might render funny, they might crash you from running out of GPU memory. I have no idea why. Try not to use DGA shirts if you have JA installed.
[*]Cooking recipes show up in the menu, but not in the collection.
[*]Recipe items (ie. in stores) don't show the correct ingredients. They show fine in the crafting menu.
[*]Big craftables recipes don't take 2 tiles on the crafting page, so they can overlap with other items. (Same with other larger items you craft, like furniture.)
[/list]
